name: Unidentified Outer Rim forest planet
description: A forested planet was located in the Outer Rim Territories. The Human male clone Irol hailed from this planet. He learned how to fly a speeder bike on his homeworld. During the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Irol became an Imperial scout trooper sergeant by 4 ABY.
